origin: Original illustrations generated for RAVEN with OpenAI ImageGen from text prompts, then cropped and encoded locally as WebP.
usage: RAVEN project artwork for the Rain Courier activity and its player-created local print editions.
thirdPartyImages: No external image or stock-art license used. All illustrations originated from text prompts for this activity.

description.ar: مرفأ مضاء بالمصابيح، بينه وبين السينما طريق مبتل.
description.en: A lamplit port and a wet road leading to the old cinema.

description.ar: الساعي بمعطفه المرجاني يغادر الرصيف تحت المطر.
description.en: The courier in a coral coat sets out from the quay in the rain.

description.ar: يعبر الساعي جدار المرفأ والريح تدفع بمعطفه.
description.en: The courier crosses the breakwater as the wind catches the coat.

description.ar: يد الساعي تلتقط الظرف من علبة الجمع الخشبية.
description.en: The courier’s hand lifts the envelope from the wooden collection tray.

description.ar: يمدّ الساعي الظرف عبر فتحة الاستلام في شباك السينما.
description.en: The courier passes the envelope through the cinema’s intake window.

description.ar: الساعي ينتظر تحت غطاء عند الرصيف فيما يهطل المطر.
description.en: The courier waits under cover by the quay as the rain falls.
